biblical_reference.note: The name Halie is derived from the Hebrew word חליא (chalya), which means 'lamentation' or 'weeping'. This name is used in the Hebrew Bible, specifically in the book of Jeremiah (4:31) and Lamentations (1:1), to describe a woman in deep sorrow and lamentation.
